title: Runway Near-Misses Rose, With Risk Concentrated In Causes And Airports
hook: The runway danger is rising, but it is not spread evenly.
closing: Concentrated causes and hotspots show where runway safety work can focus first.
question: Which runway risk worries you most?

segments.say: Serious runway near-misses reached 23 in 2023. The yearly count more than doubled from a decade earlier.
Pedestrian or vehicle deviations caused 60% of runway incursions. One category dominates the incident mix.
Eight airports account for 33% of the worst runway incursions. Serious risk clusters at a small set of locations.
